aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.metaDescription: CardAgenda lists collectible card events in Europe. Independent directory: we do not organise the shows listed.

sections.body: CardAgenda (cardagenda.com) is a directory of collectible card events in Europe (France, Belgium, the United Kingdom and other European countries): trading-card games (Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana, One Piece, Dragon Ball, Flesh and Blood, among others) and sports cards.
Listings are written from organisers’ public pages and from submissions via the site form. They are stored in a CMS (Sanity) and published on cardagenda.com.

sections.title: What CardAgenda is not
sections.body: CardAgenda does not organise the events listed. We are not the organiser, nor an official site of the game publishers. Dates, times, fees and registration: see the source on each listing.
To suggest an event, use the Submit page. For a question, use the Contact page.

contactPage.title: Contact
contactPage.metaDescription: Contact CardAgenda by email. No contact form: to list an event, use the Submit page.

sections.body: For a question about the site (listing, correction, partnership), write to the address below. There is no contact form.
To add a tournament, trade fair or convention: use the Submit page.

sections.title: Publisher
sections.body: cardagenda.com is published by Martin Perret, a natural person. No company registration number is published on this page. Publication director: Martin Perret. Contact: martin.perret@gmail.com.

sections.title: Content
sections.body: CardAgenda is a directory. Event information comes from public sources and submissions. Names, logos and event content remain those of the organisers and rights holders. Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and other mentioned trademarks belong to their owners. No affiliation.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.metaDescription: Data processed by CardAgenda: event submissions, likes cookie, hosting logs, Google AdSense script. Contact: martin.perret@gmail.com.

sections.title: Controller
sections.body: Martin Perret, publisher of cardagenda.com. Contact: martin.perret@gmail.com.

sections.title: Data collected
sections.body: The site has no user accounts. The Submit form stores event information (title, venue, dates, organiser contact, optionally an image) in Sanity, for moderation and publication. A first-party cookie named ca_event_likes stores liked event IDs in the browser, with no account.

sections.title: Hosting and ads
sections.body: Vercel, the site host, may keep technical access logs. The site loads the Google AdSense script (account ca-pub-8480412242622897). Google may set cookies and process data when ads are shown.

sections.title: Rights
sections.body: To access, correct or delete personal data, write to martin.perret@gmail.com.

cookiesPage.title: Cookies
cookiesPage.metaDescription: Cookies on CardAgenda: first-party likes cookie (ca_event_likes), technical hosting cookies, and Google AdSense cookies when ads are shown.

sections.body: CardAgenda uses a first-party cookie named ca_event_likes: it stores liked event IDs in the browser. No account, not sent to Sanity.
The host (Vercel) may set technical cookies. Google AdSense, loaded on the site, may set third-party cookies when ads are shown.
Details of data processing are on the Privacy page.
